tracks.BC/stable: Ordinary and unlogged clients use the stable track. It is intentionally disabled while the unified Windows product remains internal-test only.
tracks.BC/test: Accounts marked test in EasyLink Server receive internal test revisions.

update_control.note: EasyLink-BC.exe is the only supported Windows product. Pre-unification EasyLink-B.exe and EasyLink-C.exe are not maintained or guaranteed to auto-update.

notes: Internal-test 1.1.0.0 unified release: unlogged local sharing, login-unlocked remote access, progressive 1/2/3 remote slots, scheme-3 vehicle route selection, and BC stable/test update channels.
